recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless PA later changes Encounter participant planning semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-32347 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking why Encounter.participant.individual was optional and requesting either a required element or explanatory rationale. The final resolution required an Encounter.participant invariant like Appointment's type-or-actor rule and a note explaining how participant type can describe the actor role and that an unspecified individual during planning is expected to be filled before the encounter starts.
initial_application: Git commit 9b42c8865f716de39b17a1343b6900fece6e4e1b applied FHIR-32347 by adding Encounter participant constraint enc-1 with expression actor.exists() or type.exists(), and by appending the requested note to Encounter.participant.actor.
additional_context: FHIR-22696 had already renamed Encounter.participant.individual to Encounter.participant.actor for R5; source/fhir.ini preserves the cross-version mapping Encounter.participant.individual=@Encounter.participant.actor. Encounter is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. PA 2021 May WGM minutes record the same persuasive disposition and note text, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Encounter StructureDefinition already satisfies the approved FHIR-32347 change through enc-1 on Encounter.participant and the planning/role note on Encounter.participant.actor.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Encounter.participant.individual to Encounter.participant.actor before FHIR-32347 was applied, explaining why the current source location uses actor.
